column1: # architecture/structure.tsv — the structure declaration (change package-structure-as-five-kinds, task 1.2).
# Columns, tab-separated, on every line below that does not start with #: module, package, kind, feature, may_import.
# kind is one of concept, port, feature, platform, shell. feature is the business name a feature or platform row carries, - when the package serves several or none.
# may_import is the permission the kind's rules give, not a census of the imports the code has today: - is "nothing of ours", "any" is shell only.

# Measured 2026-11-21: 351 main sources over 30 source packages — the sources: find app/src/main/java auto/src/main/java core/src/main/java -name '*.kt' | wc -l (351); the packages: the same find piped through sed 's#/[^/]*$##' | sort -u | wc -l (30).

# One row per package as the tree stands today: a package the pilot or a later migration splits keeps its row until the files move. The favourites pilot has moved (item #981): its five files left com.naviveylin.ui.favorites, three for com.naviveylin.feature.favourites and two for com.naviveylin.platform.favourites, so the row set went 33 → 34 — one row split into two, not a row added.

# Added 2026-11-11 by change domain-vocabulary-is-declared: com.naviveylin.concept holds the skeleton types the glossary emits for a concept row no file declared, so the row set stays 1:1 with the tree.

# Added 2026-11-13 by change package-structure-as-five-kinds (task 7.1): com.naviveylin.core.port holds the pilot's port interfaces; the port files are new, no file moved, and every earlier row stands unchanged.
# Test-only packages, added 2026-11-15 by change package-structure-rules-and-suite (task 2.2) once the check
# read the test source sets: 502 test sources over 4 packages that no main source shares, measured
# find app/src/test/java auto/src/test/java core/src/test/java -name '*.kt' -o -name '*.java' | wc -l (502), all
# four under app/src/test/java. They are declared 'shell' because a test harness assembles every kind it
# exercises — the kind whose hosting the declaration permits. A fifth test-only package,
# com.naviveylin.build, is deliberately not declared: Konsist's project scope drops every path carrying a
# 'build' segment, so its 10 files are unread, and a row for them would name a package the check cannot find.
